title: Artiva Biotherapeutics Announces Multiple AlloNK® Data Presentations at EULAR 2026 Congress, Including Late-Breaking Oral Presentation Highlighting Clinical Efficacy Comparable to Autologous CAR T-Cell Therapy in Rheumatologic Diseases
summary: Late-breaking oral presentation to highlight AlloNK + rituximab clinical responses comparable to autologous CAR T-cell therapy in 31 patients with rheumatologic diseases, including 71% ACR50 response in refractory rheumatoid arthritis (RA) patients with at least six months of follow-up with no patients relapsing or requiring new immunomodulatory agents Oral presentation to feature positive experience in the first patient with severe Sjögren disease treated with AlloNK + rituximab Poster presentations to highlight deep, consistent B-cell depletion comparable to CD19 CAR T-cell therapies and a favorable safety profile in immune-mediated diseases Live post-meeting webcast to be held Monday, June 8, 2026 at 8:15 am EDT, featuring Dr. Paul Emery, Arthritis UK professor of rheumatology at the University of Leeds SAN DIEGO, May 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Artiva Biotherapeutics, Inc.
